statements.status_notes: Debian libssh2 1.11.1-1+deb13u2 includes the Encrypt-then-MAC heap overflow fix for CVE-2026-66035 in the debian.tar.xz. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-66035
Debian libssh2 1.11.1-1+deb13u2 includes the publickey response bounds checking fix for CVE-2026-66034 in the debian.tar.xz. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-66034
Debian libssh2 1.11.1-1+deb13u2 includes the AES-GCM integer underflow fix for CVE-2026-66033 in the debian.tar.xz. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-66033
Debian libssh2 1.11.1-1+deb13u2 includes the SFTP data pointer null-after-free fix for CVE-2026-66032 in the debian.tar.xz. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-66032
Debian libssh2 1.11.1-1+deb13u2 includes the publickey list initialization fix for CVE-2026-58051 in the debian.tar.xz. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-58051
Debian libssh2 1.11.1-1+deb13u2 includes the publickey attribute list size cap for CVE-2026-58050 in the debian.tar.xz. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-58050

The DHI libssh2 package backports the upstream transport.c packet_length bounds fix from https://github.com/libssh2/libssh2/commit/97acf3dfda80c91c3a8c9f2372546301d4a1a7a8 as dhi-cve-2026-55200-transport-packet-length-bound.patch, which rejects packets whose length exceeds LIBSSH2_PACKET_MAXPAYLOAD and prevents the out-of-bounds heap write.

The DHI libssh2 package backports the upstream SSH_MSG_EXT_INFO parse-failure fix from https://github.com/libssh2/libssh2/commit/17626857d20b3c9a1addfa45979dadcee1cd84a4 as upstream-cve-2026-55199.patch, which breaks the extension-parsing loop on _libssh2_get_string() failure and prevents the pre-authentication CPU-exhaustion loop.
